description.narrative: The purpose of this pre-study is to be able to develop a B2 application together with our Ukrainian partners; Ukraine Society of the Blind (UTOS) and Contemporary View (CV). We wish to get a platform to further develop our Theory of Change including context-related assumptions, to develop a specific result framework and to identify the target group for a future B2 project. Presently, UTOS and CV are implementing a B1 project (HP 411-397 Organizational development among blind organizations). As the title indicates, this project only focuses on organizational development, and in the future B2 we wish to develop and implement outcomes in the areas of empowerment, humanitarian efforts and advocacy/awareness raising. We want to ensure that the learning gathered through the implementation of the present B1 project will be incorporated into the future B2 project. We plan that representatives from the 3 organisations will meet physically during a 5 days workshop in Budapest in August 2026 to discuss and develop the above mentioned components. Last but not least, we want to create synergy and a culture of sharing and coordination in a safe space between all partners
